findings.title: Required lab-preflight check cannot pass on fork pull requests
evidence: .github/workflows/lab-preflight.yml:24 triggers on `pull_request` with a paths filter
.github/workflows/lab-preflight.yml:59 fails closed when secrets.LAB_ENDPOINT_SSH_KEY is empty
Repository is public (`gh api repos/...` visibility=public); fork PRs do not receive repo secrets
The ruleset requires context 'Lab preflight / lab' (ruleset id 24481135)
findings.impact: External contributors' PRs always show a failing required check and can never satisfy branch protection.
findings.recommendation: Skip the lab job (with a neutral/annotation) on `github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork`, or split the required check from the lab-dependent one.

findings.title: CI does not run shellcheck/actionlint on the pack's own shell/yaml despite shipping the scanners
evidence: deep-dive-deterministic.yml:76 installs shellcheck and :102 runs actionlint only in the org-scan workflow
findings.impact: Shell defects (e.g. the broken .gitignore patterns, non-exec scripts) are not gated at PR time.
findings.recommendation: Add a pack CI job that runs shellcheck on tools/**/*.sh and actionlint on .github/workflows/*.yml.

report: Reviewed all 12 workflows under `.github/workflows/`. Actions are SHA-pinned and jobs declare `permissions:`; the reusable lab-preflight gate and the required-check drift are covered under branch protection.
